scenes.title: Goal
scenes.narration: This video checks story R M S 6142. Three Maryland I B R fields, Household Code, Hate Bias Status and Hate Group Name, should now be published to reporting. We check each acceptance criterion in turn.

scenes.title: Report Manager
scenes.narration: Reporting starts in Report Manager. Update Reporting Fields refreshes the fields that reports can use, and Enterprise Print Designer Maintenance holds the custom forms.

scenes.title: Criterion 1: fields in Dynamic Reporting
scenes.narration: For criterion one, we start a new Dynamic Report on the Case module. Household Code, Hate Bias Status and Hate Group Name should all be listed in the field picker.

scenes.title: Criterion 3: Case Standard Detail report
scenes.narration: For criterion three, we find the Case Standard Detail report. Its configuration should list the three fields as available, but not selected to print by default.
